X 早报 · 2026-11-18（周三）

概览

过去 24 小时的焦点仍是英伟达：财报显示需求远超供给，云行业积压订单从 2 万亿美元升至 2.5 万亿美元，Hopper 重签价翻倍、B300 租价涨超 60%，未来供应承诺升至 5180 亿美元；但临时 CEO Kress 称不考虑请回黄仁勋，Semafor 却报道部分董事仍在推动其回归，贝索斯也公开表示不会找外部 CEO。政治上，特朗普抵达深圳出席 APEC，习近平亲自到停机坪迎接，随后美、中、俄三国元首举行史上首次三边会晤；同时有中文博主称英伟达将停止向中国销售任何 GPU，路透称白宫考虑要求美企披露对中国 AI 模型的使用。宏观方面，美联储理事沃勒罕见呼吁立即加息 50 个基点以“震醒”通胀预期，但认为 AI 定价没有泡沫；10 月保证金债务回落但仍处历史第四高，金价较峰值下跌约 31%。科技与文化方面，旅行者 1 号成为首个距地球一光日的人造物体，帝国大厦点亮金色致敬；GTA VI 以 99 分 Metascore 追平《时之笛》史上最高分，Take-Two 大涨约 7%。

英伟达：财报余波与黄仁勋去留

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：据 Semafor 报道，英伟达（$NVDA）董事会中的“一派”成员正在推动黄仁勋复任 CEO，尽管董事会已公开表示并未考虑让他回归。
据报道，黄仁勋已与多位科技公司高管会面，并与至少一名英伟达董事讨论了回归 CEO 的可能性。

原文：BREAKING: "A faction" of Nvidia, $NVDA, board members is pushing for Jensen Huang to return as CEO, despite the board publicly stating that it is not considering his return, per Semafor.
Jensen Huang has reportedly met with numerous tech executives and spoken with at least one Nvidia board member about the possibility of returning as CEO.

$NVDA 财报电话会文字稿 + 产业链解读。一句话总结：“需求远超供给”。
- 对 $MU / 三星等存储多头是好消息：
“我们的供应承诺从上季度的 2790 亿美元增至 3900 亿美元，主要与多年期存储采购有关。”（来自 SEC 文件，而非电话会）
这是供应采购规模的一次重大环比跃升。
- “我们预计营收将同比增长约 75%，高于此前的 70%。”（上调预期，可能是因为产能约束有所缓解）
（与景硕和三星电机的新协议为额外的 ABF 载板产能提供支持）
- 英伟达表示，云行业积压订单在一个季度内从 2 万亿美元增至 2.5 万亿美元，而 GPU 租赁价格仍在大幅上涨：
Hopper GPU：为最初价格的 2 倍
B300 GPU：自推出以来上涨 60%
利用率：英伟达称，其在所服务的超大规模云厂商和新兴云厂商中的算力已全部用满。
- “我们的共封装光学（CPO）路线图仍按计划推进”
光网络业务持续快速增长（季度网络营收超 210 亿美元），CPO 横向扩展交换机已进入量产。Lambda 此前也宣布已在生产环境部署英伟达光子 CPO 交换机。
- “根据这些协议，我们将从基础设施的前期销售中获得收入”，因此新兴云厂商还会带来额外的经常性收益。
总之，这一切都指向从存储到 CPO 再到新兴云的产业加速，而市场却在为崩盘定价。

原文：$NVDA earnings transcript + industry read through. To sum it up: "Demand far exceeds supply".
- Good news for the $MU / Samsung memory longs:
"Our supply commitments increased from $279B last quarter to $390B, primarily related to the multi-year procurement of memory supply". (from SEC filings, not call)
This is a a major leap Q/Q in supply procurement.
- "We expect revenue to grow approximately 75% year-over-year, up from 70%." (upward revision, likely due to capacity constraints easing)
(new agreements with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics support additional ABF substrate capacity)
- NVIDIA said industry cloud backlog increased from $2 trillion to $2.5 trillion in a single quarter. While GPU rental pricing is continuing to rise dramatically:
Hopper GPUs: 2x their original pricing
B300 GPUs: +60% since introduction
Utilization: NVIDIA says its own compute is fully utilized across the hyperscalers and neoclouds it serves.
- "Our co-packaged optics roadmap remains on track"
Optical networking keeps growing rapidly ($21B+ in quarterly networking), CPO scale out switches has entered volume production. With Lambda earlier announcing production deployment of Nvidia photonics CPO switches.
- "Under these agreements, we will earn revenue on the upfront sale of our infrastructure" So there's additional recurring economics coming from Neoclouds.
But just points to industry acceleration from memory to CPO to neoclouds, relative to markets pricing in collapse.

英伟达正在扩大长期供应链协议，以确保当前及下一代 AI 基础设施的制造产能。
$NVDA 的未来承诺总额从上季度的 3660 亿美元升至 5180 亿美元，其中 3900 亿美元为供应与产能承诺，主要由多年期存储采购推动。
英伟达扩张制造供应链的方式如下：
• 景硕：计划将台湾专供英伟达的载板产能扩大 3.5 倍以上，另有产能目标在 2028 年第三季度投产。
• 三星电机：在韩国现有工厂扩充载板生产能力。
• Amkor：此前已宣布的近 30 亿美元协议，支持其在亚利桑那和韩国扩充先进芯片封装产能。
• 矽品（SPIL）：英伟达提供数十亿美元资金，扩充其在台湾的先进封装产能，新增产能预计 2029 年年中到位。
• 富士康：利用其全球制造网络支持下一代 GPU 和网络系统的生产。
英伟达还确认，Vera Rubin NVL72 和 Vera CPU 已于第三财季开始批量出货，采用台积电 5nm、3nm 制程以及 CoWoS 先进封装技术。

原文：Nvidia is expanding its long-term supply-chain agreements to secure manufacturing capacity for current and next-gen AI Infra.
$NVDA’s total future commitments rose to $518B from $366B last qtr, including $390B in supply & capacity, largely driven by multi-year memory purchases.
Here’s how Nvidia is expanding its manufacturing supply chain:
• Kinsus: Plans to expand substrate capacity dedicated to Nvidia by more than 3.5x in Taiwan, with additional capacity targeted for Q3 2028.
• Samsung Electro-Mechanics: Expanding substrate production capabilities at existing factories in South Korea.
• Amkor: Nearly $3B in previously announced agreements supporting advanced chip packaging expansion in Arizona and South Korea.
• SPIL: Multibillion-dollar funding from Nvidia to expand advanced packaging capacity in Taiwan, with additional capacity expected by mid-2029.
• Foxconn: Using its global manufacturing network to support production of next-generation GPUs and networking systems.
Nvidia also confirmed that Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs began volume shipments in fiscal Q3, using TSMC’s 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies.

原文：FED'S WALLER CALLS FOR A 50 BPS HIKE
Fed Governor Christopher Waller says the Fed should raise rates by 50 basis points now, unless it signals a more aggressive pace ahead in its statement or press conference.
He is very concerned inflation is moving in the wrong direction and broadening, with roughly 70% of items in the core services basket running above 3%, which he said is not related to oil.
The Fed may need to "shock" people out of expecting 3% inflation. Fed may have to do more than reverse the cuts it made last year. The FOMC minutes are due at 2 p.m. ET.

Despite recent volatility, this market remains highly levered.

With consumer spending accounting for ~70% of US GDP, strong stock market gains continue to support the broader economy.

两天后，这两个理由都靠不住了。
今天早上我把整件事从头复盘了一遍，结论是：这不是两周的事，引线埋了四年。
2022 年美国出台首轮对华 AI 芯片禁令，黄仁勋的应对主要是商业上的：推出降规版芯片接着卖，嘴上批评管制，但没有亲自下场游说白宫。

不管今晚结果如何，我都会在开盘后平掉全部 $NVDA 期权。即使罢免没通过，放料的人手里可能还有东西，短期看不清。
